review.assessment: This change introduces a brand-new `solution.py` containing only the original naive nested-loop implementation of `has_pair_with_sum`. It completely omits any algorithmic optimization, leaving the function running in O(n²) time instead of the requested roughly linear time. Consequently, while small inputs pass the acceptance test, the performance requirement is fundamentally unmet and would fail on any meaningful scale.

findings.actual: Runtime scales quadratically due to nested loops iterating over all distinct pairs `(i, j)`.
